significance.p_value_note: 0 of 10000 bootstrap resamples had mean delta <= 0; reported resolution is < 1/10000 = 0.0001, not exactly 0.

bm25_ndcg10_discrepancy_note: BM25 NDCG@10 computed on the LambdaMART-matched candidate pool (extract_test_advanced_features) = 0.8155, which differs from the previously-recorded all-locale BM25 baseline of 0.8188 (scripts/build_query_slices.py, reproduced and verified against a 0.001 tolerance in that script). The two numbers come from different candidate-pool construction paths: build_query_slices.py merges bm25_scores_test.csv directly against ESCI labels with no locale filter; extract_test_advanced_features additionally joins the products table on product_id only (not product_id+locale, a pre-existing issue already documented in scripts/analyze_topk_overlap.py) and applies dropna(subset=feature_cols). Per Task 3 instructions, 0.8155 is the number used here because it is computed on the identical query/candidate set as the LambdaMART model.
